_about: One character's own settings for the build. Copy to <characters>/<name>/layers/full/live2d.json and keep only the lines she needs. Most characters need no such file. The names are her layers' names, as `live2d.py status <name>` lists them.
_tucked: A top tucked into a skirt: the top is drawn under the skirt and grown a little downward where the skirt hides it, so no gap opens at her waist when she moves.
_whole: Layers that are part of her body and must not swing or be cut into limbs, such as ["topwear", "coat back"] for a long open coat, or ["handwear"] for arms that touch her body.
_rims: false leaves the pale line on her edges as it is: for a character drawn with a light outline of her own.
why: One line on what you saw that made you add this, for whoever reads it next.
